reddit.title: When the Colony Talks Back: Enhancements to Your Settlement Experience
reddit.body: We're excited to share some new features that make your colony more interactive and responsive! With thought badges on settlers, real-time problem alerts, and a compact stats panel, your settlement will communicate its needs and issues more clearly than ever. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back
